summary: Typing to search the Source Data table list no longer sends the caret back to the start of the box.
details: The Table Or View field is now the search box itself; the separate search box inside the dropdown was removed.
Each keystroke used to rebuild the search box, which reset the caret to the first character; only the list is rebuilt now, so typing behaves normally.
Server Name and Database Name also filter their saved-value dropdowns as you type.
